content: On the other hand, Japanese and Vietnamese are different to those languages in the way of how we consider a word. In Vietnamese, the TU, normally considered as a word, which often separated to each others by white spaces, is not a word in linguistic term since it does not really have its own meaning. Therefore, applying BPE to segment those TUs into smaller units without any modification is not suitable for Vietnamese. In case of Japanese, there are no space to separate written texts into TUs. Thus, for Vietnamese and Japanese as well as for the languages having similar problem, before applying BPE, it is necessary to have some preprocessing step to tokenize the texts into words.
